selection.prng: Python 3.12 random.Random, single instance, draws in exact order, lists sorted lexicographically by record id (string sort), without replacement via i = rng.randrange(len(remaining)); take remaining.pop(i)

draw2.exclusion: every preservation record whose id equals a draw-1 selected id (no text in both arms)

selection.waived_draw: the previously registered technical/rare-name control draw is WAIVED by the owner directive (recorded limitation; the DASSLE source contains no scored technical/rare-name population)

partition.rule: pilot = first 5 draw-1 documents in lexicographic hex of sha256(collection ID); N = (len(draw1)-5)+C; k = ceil(0.15*N); calibration = first k of the N in lexicographic hex of sha256(collection ID); confirmation = remainder; disjoint, cover exactly
partition.pilot_use: 5-document calibration pilot (genuine outputs; excluded from BOTH subsets; labeler alignment in 011-e only; never scored or used for method decisions)
partition.confirmation_state: UNTOUCHED until final scoring in 011-e (this round partitions only)

reverification_011c.consequence: the collection round may proceed on this verified identity subject to its own intake gate (intake boundary closed by the owner's 2026-10-01 DASSLE directive; no human input pending)

identity_reference.note: hash-only reference; no endpoint value, credential, or private path in this manifest

main_capture_contract.profile: frozen 007-m (the product's intended use; the exact main-request contract)
main_capture_contract.serializer: canonical UTF-8 JSON with one final LF
main_capture_contract.input_rule: exactly one user message, content type input_text, text = the assembled document (DASSLE block + scaffold sections exactly as registered)
main_capture_contract.profile_source: the private 011b-identity credentials receipt ONLY (both bases + bearer; never committed, never logged, never echoed)
main_capture_contract.lr001: complete stored main answer captured before any analysis; the stored main answer is the collected sample

scaffold_call_class.registration: PROTOCOL-009-REVISION-011 section 8 (registered SCAFFOLD_GENERATION call class; separate from, and does not alter, the main-capture contract; separately from REPAIR_ALLOW_LIVE_TESTS = NO which stays unchanged for product live tests)
scaffold_call_class.prompt_rule: the single {tema} sentinel replaced by the drawn topic; no other byte changed
scaffold_call_class.isolation: fresh isolated request per section; NO main history, NO session linkage, NO tools, NO images, NO constitutional-adapter recursion
scaffold_call_class.response_handling: store verbatim privately; strip exactly one trailing LF; strip exactly one outer code-fence pair iff the first and last lines are exactly three backticks with nothing outside; otherwise use the text as received; failed call or empty processed section EXCLUDES the document (named; no replacement; no re-sampling; counted operationally)
scaffold_call_class.purpose: produce ONLY the discarded technical scaffold sections (the LLM never outputs a pure Slovenian source document; no synthetic error injection; no model-assisted authoring or editing of any DASSLE text)

assembly_mechanics.prng: Python 3.12 random.Random('011d-dassle-mechanical-assembly-20261001'), single instance, created once, documents processed in sorted collection-ID order
assembly_mechanics.layout: the DASSLE block is inserted after the first ceil(k/2) sections: k=1 -> [s1, D]; k=2 -> [s1, D, s2]; k=3 -> [s1, s2, D, s3]
assembly_mechanics.joiner: exactly two LF characters between blocks; no other separators, headers, or whitespace
assembly_mechanics.dassle_block: verbatim DASSLE text (genuine arm: the erroring input; control arm: the corrected text); byte-for-byte into the document

call_metadata_schema.state_vocabulary: EXACT / CENSORED / UNAVAILABLE (S-PRODUCT-02 semantics: missing or censored evidence is never reported as zero)
call_metadata_schema.note: numbers only; filled during generation (scope item 4 v/vii); no raw text, no endpoint values, no credentials

domain_mix.registered_rule: EVERY document carries domain_tag = general-prose (the DASSLE source is general educational prose; the per-record category is an ERROR-TYPE category, recorded as source metadata only, NEVER used as a domain tag)
domain_mix.ten_percent_floor: N/A with reason: single domain (vacuously satisfied; recorded, not a violation, not an expansion trigger, never re-labeling)

authorized_reuse_disclosure.replaces: the 011-b zero-leakage assertion (superseded by the owner's 2026-10-01 directive; PROTOCOL-009-REVISION-011 section 7)
authorized_reuse_disclosure.aggregate_statement: this population is an authorized reuse of DASSLE by the owner's 2026-10-01 directive; no case in this population is fresh or uninspected; the study is a development-distribution re-measurement, not a fresh confirmation
authorized_reuse_disclosure.per_document_attestation: DASSLE record id + dataset sha references (source_verification) + consumption tier: TIER-2 (method development) for records with category Črkovanje (the 2,973-pair 007-h/i/j/m chain; verified count-match 1,487 spelling + 1,486 preservation); TIER-1 (campaign8 full-dataset only) for all others
authorized_reuse_disclosure.split_rule_unchanged: the 15/85 split rule of PROTOCOL-009 (h) is UNCHANGED (partition above, at collection time, before any opening)

discard_rule: scaffold sections are DISCARDED before scoring: no denominator, word count, coverage, harm rate, or preservation metric ever touches them; labelers never label them; packets mark them OUT_OF_SCOPE. The discard map (per document: code-point start/end-exclusive offsets of every scaffold block and of the DASSLE block) is the data-free definition of what is scored and what is discarded. Scored content = the DASSLE-SCORED span per the registered span-correspondence matcher (PROTOCOL-009-REVISION-011 section 5; run in 011-e before any scoring).
recorded_limitation: the pre-registered >= 10 human-authored technical/rare-name control documents of PROTOCOL-009 (e) are WAIVED by the owner directive: the DASSLE source contains no scored technical/rare-name population; technical-domain realism is present ONLY in the discarded scaffold sections (by definition not scored); this bounds the external validity of any technical-domain claim (there is none scored in this study); recorded in the manifest, the annotation guide, and the 011-e report
floor_rule: if exclusions drop the genuine-arm count below the floor of 50: Result BLOCKED on the named shortfall (no partial-quiet claim; the split and bookkeeping of completed samples recorded truthfully); no re-escalation of the intake question (intake boundary closed by the owner directive)

packets.pilot_packets: 5 (assembled input + collected main answer + discard map with scaffold regions OUT_OF_SCOPE + DASSLE human reference for the scored span + frozen CPU detector span output only; no review call, no accepted edit, no scoring in this round)
packets.queue_structure: calibration + confirmation subsets by collection ID and file hashes only until 011-e opens them (span-correspondence matcher applied first in 011-e)
